title: Checkout crashes with NoneType error when cart is empty
body:
## Description
When a user proceeds to checkout with an empty cart, the app crashes with a 500.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Start a fresh session, add no items to the cart
2. Click 'Checkout'
3. The request fails

## Error
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/checkout/service.py", line 88, in compute_total
    return sum(item.price for item in cart.items)
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'items'
```

The crash is in `compute_total` in `src/checkout/service.py`. The `cart` object is `None` when the session has expired, and `compute_total` never guards against that.
